Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

 

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & -5 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-6+6 & -4+3+0 & -5+12-18 \\ -1+0+2 & 4+0+0 & 5+0-6 \\ 0-2-2 & 0+1+0 & 0+4+6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -11 \\ 1 & 4 & -1 \\ -4 & 1 & 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
